correctness.rationale: For an F2-linear code of Hamming diameter <=4, maximal nonzero weight <=4. RREF gives dim k<=4 via pivot-column sum; each nonzero column occurs in 2^(k-1) of all 2^k codewords, so support size s obeys s*2^(k-1)<=4(2^k-1) and s<=7. Every full-support code in this finite (s<=7,k<=4) rectangle is counted exhaustively via RREF pivot/free-column matrices and independently via full-rank multisets of k-bit nonzero columns, tested for all codeword weights, with multinomial weights divided by |GL(k,2)|. Independent complete RREF enumeration confirmed all 40 rank-support cells, totals by s = (1,1,2,6,26,91,100,30), making global B(n,k)=sum_s a(s,k) C(n,s) valid for ALL n>=0. At s=7 k<3 ruled out by weight sum, k=4 contradicted by second moments; k=3 forces all seven nonzero columns of F2^3, yielding exactly 7!/|GL(3,2)|=30 labeled simplex copies. Finite coefficient computation is exhaustive because of proved bounds, not inference from a sample of ambient n.
residual_risks: Proof of every displayed coefficient relies on a finite exhaustive algorithm, not a hand-derivation for each of forty cells.
